Subject: Re: Fwd: Skyline incident — ops please verify failover timeline and pool saturation

All — ops verification complete. Findings summary for Laura to send to customer:

- Confirmed unusable window as defined by the contract: 2026-11-13T08:41:52Z to 2026-11-13T09:05:13Z (UTC timestamps in bundle).
- Root cause: aggressive routing to a replenishing pool in us-west-2 while a scheduled capacity reshuffle was in progress; the target pool experienced transient queue saturation and transient preemptions (two GPUs) which caused elevated 429s and timeouts.
- Evidence: request router logs + host metrics included in trace_bundle_20261113.zip (redacted).
- Preliminary credit calc: 24.35 minutes of confirmed unavailability. Using the contract monthly service rate and the pro-rata formula, preliminary credit equals one-day pro-rata equivalent; see attached prelim_credit_calc.xlsx for math. This is subject to final verification and accounting rounding.

Next steps recommended for customer communication:
1) Share the confirmed window and attach the redacted trace bundle.
2) Offer the preliminary credit calc and note final accounting will issue a formal credit memo in 7–10 business days.
3) Commit to an RCA delivery timeline: detailed incident report (RCA + mitigation plan) by EOD Thursday (2026-11-19).

Sooj: please mark follow-up mitigation ticket for autoscaler / pool-scheduling adjustments and include canary rollout plan to avoid simultaneous replenishment.

Rishi
Director of Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference
